name: kiro-cli-agent
description: Run the kiro-cli agent (acp:kiro-cli) over ACP. This provider activates only when the `kiro-cli` binary is present on the machine, and is unavailable otherwise.
author: PersonalClaw

launches.why: kiro-cli does the work of each chat. PersonalClaw starts it as kiro-cli acp and talks to it over ACP.

x-meta.label: Default Model
x-meta.help: Optional model the agent defaults to. Empty uses the kiro CLI's own default.

x-meta.label: CLI Path
x-meta.help: Optional absolute path to the kiro-cli binary. Empty auto-resolves via PATH. Equivalent to the KIRO_CLI_BIN env var.
